data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Moreen is a name derived from the sea goddess Mora or Moria. She was believed to protect sailors and fishermen, and was revered for her nurturing and maternal qualities. The name Moreen carries the meaning “Sea goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Moreen usually hope their child will grow to embody sea goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
